Film 'Verity' Receives A Certificate in India After Scene Cuts

The film 'Verity', starring Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson, has received an A certificate in India after 23 seconds of intimate scenes were cut. Reviews suggest the thriller, based on a Colleen Hoover novel, did not meet expectations and has been described as a second-rate copy of 'The Housemaid'. The movie also features Josh Hartnett.
